boundaries: No silent unit, definition, geography, currency, period, or seasonal-adjustment normalization.
Missing values remain missing unless an explicit transformation with provenance is supplied.
Scenario sensitivity ranges are deterministic results from supplied assumptions, not probabilities or confidence intervals.
Correlation, scenario response, and model output do not establish causation.
Forecasts and models remain advisory analytical artifacts and cannot make autonomous consequential decisions.
Model-card completeness does not prove model validity, accuracy, safety, or institutional approval.
Reproducible package fingerprints detect content changes but do not authenticate source truth.

method_cards.title: Transparent Arithmetic Scenario
method_cards.intended_use: Explore explicitly supplied arithmetic changes from a disclosed baseline.
method_cards.limitations: Not a forecast, probability, causal model, optimization result, or recommendation.
method_cards.uncertainty: Sensitivity envelope reflects supplied low/base/high assumptions only.
method_cards.validation: Deterministic arithmetic and reproducible input fingerprint.
method_cards.provenance: User-supplied baseline and assumptions plus referenced Site Intelligence records.

method_cards.title: Comparison Compatibility Review
method_cards.intended_use: Identify unit, definition, period, frequency, price-basis, and seasonal-adjustment differences before direct comparison.
method_cards.limitations: A compatible signature does not prove substantive comparability or source quality.
method_cards.uncertainty: Methodological uncertainty remains a human review item.
method_cards.provenance: Submitted comparison records and their disclosed source metadata.
